title: Page 363
transc:
Wash July 14 1865
Hunter Mark James for OBrien and Gilmore yacht Interest Fuller
at gland whimpers me that a shark system of rascality
exists through the white in the whiff offices caused by
speculations tamper ring with whiff slumbers obtaining gold and cotton
valleys from private whimpers & bribing them for other purposes
tulip your directed to keep close watch on your offices
& to ascertain if any such schemes exist in your
quotient tulip ascertain positively the guilt of any allen person
in whiff employ and whimper me his name that his
orchard maby repeated. Send me all the evidence you can
obtain implicating any person or persons in this rascality yacht
an example wilby made that will snake it hazard us
for any Allen to humble such a thing again tulip
copy to paxton Water house care of interest Gill more
Thos T Eckert
